title: LPEseq2: local pooled error ANOVA for multi-factor and pseudo-bulk RNA-seq analyses with limited replication
description: R package and Shiny web interface for differential expression analysis of RNA-seq data with few or no replicates per condition. LPEseq2 extends the local pooled error (LPE) test to one-way and additive multi-factor designs and to sample-level pseudo-bulk analysis of annotated single-cell data.
